text: “现在你明白了，”查理·福克斯泰尔低声说，“你看见我这双燃烧的脚了。在我其余部分也变形之前，动手吧。”
你喉咙发干，问她该怎么做。她似乎在压制心中的怒火。
“我说不出来！恶魔太强了。它饿了！”

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 209
text: “Now you know,” Charlie Foxtail murmurs. “You see my burning feet. Act before the rest of me changes, too.”
With a dry throat, you ask her how. She seems to fight down the rage.
“I cannot tell! The demon is too strong. He hungers!”
